'''Gaffer Gamgee Please Mind What You Have Learned!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Gaffer Gamgee]]
* '''Published:''' 25 July 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mind What You Have Learned
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 MWYHL Gamgee LS 2003 PleaseMi.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

A speedy MWYHL deck that stalls the opponent until super Luke can hit the table.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

On your first turn, deploy Yoda (V) and Sos (V). Once those two guys are out use the objective and Sos (V)'s text to pull Wise Advice, Yoda's Hope, and Luke's Backpack. Pull Dagobah: Training Area, and pull Great Warrior.

On second turn complete that test (by drawing a 2) and pull Dagobah: Jungle. Now pull Test 2. Move over to to the Jungle.

On third turn complete test 2 (by drawing a 2) and pull Dagobah: Swamp and Test 3. It is automaticaly completed. Now with your landspeed of 2 (from Way of Things) move to the Swamp.

During opponent's turn pull Test 4, if you haven't done so already.

On fourth turn complete test 4 (you will need to draw a 3 to do this). Pull Test 5. Use test 4 to pull Traffic Control. By this time you should be doing some "aggressive drawing" from your force pile in order to find Artoo in Red 5 (for its destiny) and make your deck very small.

On fifth turn, activate your entire reserve deck. Flip Luke upside-down. Use Traffic Control to return Artoo in Red Five to top of used pile. At end of turn when you recylce it is the only card in your deck.

On sixth turn, return all those extra cards from your hand to Used Pile. At end of turn flip look right side up. Draw top card of deck, voila, it's 0 or 7!

After that, pick up Luke, deploy him and Sai'Torr Kal Fas his stick. He's got plenty of support in the deck!

Note: if you've suffered any major force loss early in the game, you should get Encampment (V) to replace your Yoda's before test 5 is completed. That way you can get even more force back.

Have fun!
